company.shortDescription: Bookmypet is an online Market place APP and Website catering to both Pet care providers and Pet parents in the Gulf region
company.description: Bookmypet is a UAE-based pet care marketplace and mobile app connecting pet owners with grooming, boarding, daycare, veterinary, walking, sitting, and pet taxi services. Operating across the UAE and KSA, the platform also offers pet food, accessories, loyalty rewards, and personalized pet management solutions, delivering convenient, technology-driven experiences for modern pet parents and trusted service providers.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,501,426 to $14,600,703, a 1.95x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 90 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 76 (+5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
